modelNotes: Threes Board 1.0 uses season threes, last 5 threes, last 10 threes, three point attempts, attempt trend, expected minutes, minutes confidence, and usage.
Threes Board 2.0 adds minutes scaling, opponent three rank, pace, rest, teammate absence redistribution, volatility, and floor/ceiling ranges.
No odds or betting lines are used.

injury.shortComment: Quickley (hamstring) is questionable for Friday against the Bucks.
injury.detail: Quickley was a late addition to the injury report and is dealing with some tightness. Presumably, the Raptors are considering a maintenance day here. Jamal Shead would be the next man up for Toronto.

injury.shortComment: Hunter is questionable for Friday against the Spurs due to an illness.
injury.detail: Hunter is a late addition to the injury report. If he doesn't suit up Friday, Malik Monk and Leaky Black should soak up more playing time for the Kings.

injury.shortComment: Christie (hip) is probable for Friday's game against the Jazz.
injury.detail: The swingman is primed to end a one-game absence Friday due to a hip injury. Christie had been starting at shooting guard for the Mavericks before getting hurt, but it remains to be seen if 2024 No. 1 overall pick Zaccharie Risacher has played well enough to keep his hold on a starting job.

injury.shortComment: Watson (hamstring) is questionable for Friday's game against the 76ers.
injury.detail: Watson has missed his team's last two matchups due to a hamstring issue, and he's in danger of missing a third Friday. More information on his availability should come to light as tipoff nears.

injury.shortComment: Barnes (adductor) was not present at the morning shootaround, Michael Grange of Sportsnet.careports.
injury.detail: This is an ominous sign for Barnes' availability Friday -- he remains listed questionable on the official injury report. The Raptors may need to lean on Allen Graves, Jamison Battle and Collin Murray-Boyles if Barnes is unable to give it a go.

injury.shortComment: Allen (knee) is questionable for Friday's game against Philadelphia.
injury.detail: Allen picked up a right knee injury during Wednesday's clash against the Thunder and failed to return. He'll presumably be monitored closely leading up to tipoff to determine if he can take the court Friday night.

injury.shortComment: Poeltl (shoulder) is listed as probable for Friday's game against Milwaukee.
injury.detail: Poeltl is still a little banged up for Toronto, but he intends to push through it. On Wednesday against Denver, he played 19 minutes off the bench with eight points, five rebounds and one assist.

injury.shortComment: Anderson is questionable for Friday against the Bucks due to illness.
injury.detail: Anderson is averaging 6.1 minutes across six appearances so far. His status won't carry much weight in fantasy hoops.
